[12:18:47] Combine all data for post `Byju's an edtech company operated by Think and Learn Pvt. Ltd. Has reportedly raised funds from the US based Tiger Global Management. Thought the amount raised has not been revealed by the company, several media reports suggest that the numbers are about $200 million at a valuation of ₹8 billion. What else expected are the secondary transactions which is estimated between $200-200 million. According to sources, this is offering exists to certain Startup's early backers. Investors like Sequoia Capital a India, Bennett Coleman and Co. Ltd, Innoven Capital, General Atlantic, Tencent and Light speed India Partners participated. Tiger Global Partner Scott Sheiger separated stated that that firm seemed to be confident in its investment in the edtech startup since the firm has proven to be a leader in the sector along with its technology which focusses on offering learning solutions for students in India. As per the company's claims it's revenue at the 2019 financial year stood at 1,480 crore and that it is on its way to take it to Rs. 3,000 crore for this fiscal year. Their claims are to have 42 million registered users at present out which at least 3 million are paid subscribers in both rural and urban areas of the country. Notably this is known to be amongst the most heavily funded start-ups. It's valuation is known to have crossed $5 billion post raising $31. 3 million in March in a funding round last year which was lead by current investors GENERAL Atlantic and Tencent Holdings Ltd. Another announcement bByju'sin December 2018 suggested that it managed to secure ₹540 million in a round led by South Africa tech Conglomerate Naspers. Tiger Global's bet- The latest bet by Tiger Global is the investment in Byju's. While in December, last year, a $20 million Series A funding round was led by the company in the business to business marketplace for real estate and construction materials Infra.market. Other participators in the round were Nexus Venture Partners. A Series B funding round worth $23 million was led by the company in September. This investment was in Wow!Momo Foods Pvt. Ltd. Which is known for operating and owning brands Wow! Momo and Wow! China. Reportedly a $42 million Series C funding round in edtech startup Vedantu Innovations along with WestBridge Capital, a private equity firm got led by the investor. Tiger Global also participated in a $120 million funding round in Cred, a fintech startup and invested about $15 million in an AI based wealth management venture, INDwealth`...
